Model questions

QED1530 FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the QED1530?

The stated rated capacity is 1,500 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the QED1530?

The listed lift specification is 3,000 mm configurable. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the QED1530?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
